name: Lighthouse of Lost Frequencies
description: A lighthouse standing on a rocky shore of vinyl records, its beam not light but sound waves made visible — concentric rings of color pulsing to forgotten radio signals, whale songs, and lullabies.
prompt: Tall lighthouse on rocky shore made of stacked vinyl records with visible grooves, beacon emits visible sound waves as concentric rings of synesthetic color — each frequency a different hue pulsing outward, radio static white noise, deep whale song blues, lullaby pinks, forgotten voices gold, waves crash as waveform patterns on record-rock shore, stormy sky with frequency spectrum clouds, long exposure light painting aesthetic, 8k, moody atmospheric
caption:
Some lights guide ships. This one guides souls home. 📻🌊

Every lost song finds its way back to shore.
